select reservation_seq.nextval from dual
insert into reservation (res_no, res_num, res_name, res_tel, res_day, res_time, res_count, res_price, res_stats, res_wait, res_reg_date, res_update, u_no, r_no) values (#{res_no}, (select to_char(nvl(max(to_number(res_num)), 0) + 1) from reservation where r_no = #{r_no} and res_day = #{res_day}), #{res_name}, #{res_tel}, #{res_day}, #{res_time}, #{res_count}, #{res_price, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{res_stats}, (select count(*) from reservation where r_no = #{r_no} and res_day = #{res_day} and res_stats = '대기중'), SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{u_no, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{r_no, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.update: update reservation set res_name = #{res_name}, res_tel = #{res_tel}, res_day = #{res_day}, res_time = #{res_time}, res_count = #{res_count}, res_stats = #{res_stats}, res_update = SYSDATE where res_no = #{res_no}
mapper.select: select r.*, rt.r_name from reservation r left join restaurant rt on r.r_no = rt.r_no where r.u_no = #{u_no} and r.res_stats = '대기중' order by r.res_day asc
select r.*, rt.r_name from reservation r left join restaurant rt on r.r_no = rt.r_no where r.u_no = #{u_no} and r.res_stats = '완료' order by r.res_day desc
select r.*, rt.r_name from reservation r left join restaurant rt on r.r_no = rt.r_no where r.res_tel = #{res_tel} and r.res_name = #{res_name} and r.res_stats = '대기중' order by r.res_day desc
select count(*) from reservation where r_no = #{r_no} and res_day = #{res_day} and res_stats = '대기중'
select * from reservation where r_no = #{r_no} and res_stats = '대기중' order by res_day asc
mapper.update: update reservation set res_wait = ( select count(*) from reservation r2 where r2.r_no = reservation.r_no and r2.res_day = reservation.res_day and r2.res_stats = '대기중' and r2.res_reg_date < reservation.res_reg_date ) where r_no = #{r_no} and res_day = #{res_day} and res_stats = '대기중'
